title: Separate critical event processing from routine polling
body: MIRA keeps routine state acquisition on the polling path while providing a separate asynchronous event path for events where near-real-time handling is required.

attributes.statement: Use polling for routine state acquisition and an asynchronous webhook lane for events requiring near-real-time processing.
attributes.rationale: Routine reminder state does not require an event-driven dependency, while some events benefit from immediate processing. Separating the two paths provides timely handling without making the entire ingestion architecture dependent on push delivery.

alternatives_rejected.reason: It would introduce a push dependency across a heterogeneous Laravel and WordPress fleet.

alternatives_rejected.alternative: Use polling for every event regardless of urgency
alternatives_rejected.reason: It unnecessarily delays events where near-real-time processing is required.
